how_to_fill: Per UNIDENTIFIED entry: add a curated row to CURATED_IDENTIFICATIONS in scripts/build_forecast_dof_ledger.py citing committed evidence (registry citation, frozen derive script, or published-source intake finding), with its expected value or registry cross-check, then regenerate the ledger. A `residual` identification MUST carry `root_cause` naming an OPEN issue (CLAUDE.md rule 21 [R-DOF]). dispatch_mechanism entries should CITE the ISO's backcast keeper ledger entry and state whether the identification survives extrapolation forward. Never hand-edit the emitted JSON: the curated table is the reviewed, committed surface.
verdict_effect: None from emission alone — this lane re-scores nothing. On a chartered FC-7 re-score: any UNIDENTIFIED entry keeps the same CAVEAT an absent ledger draws (forecast_verdict.py treats `unattested` as not-identified); only a ledger whose every entry carries a real identification can retire it.
